title: Drive to Sulaymaniyah & Amna Suraka
full_text:
Late departure and head to Sulaymaniyah.
Arrival in Sulaymaniyah, explore the city’s Bazaar and visit the Red Museum (Amna Suraka).
Late Lunch at a traditional Kurdish restaurant.
Optional visit to the Maryam Adhra Monastery, offering a unique cultural experience.
Evening walk along Salem Street to enjoy vibrant nightlife, street food, and coffee/tea stalls.
